research_rationale:
Executive Order 14033 (June 8, 2021, 86 FR 31079) expands the national emergency declared in Executive Order 13219 to the destabilizing situation in the Western Balkans, blocks property of persons contributing to it and suspends their entry. The order is operative on 2026-10-14. Its text has no sunset, expiry condition or revocation trigger. It depends on the Executive Order 13219 emergency, which the held Presidential notices of June 13, 2022 (87 FR 36051), June 20, 2023 (88 FR 40683), June 13, 2024 (89 FR 51201), June 20, 2025 (90 FR 26917) and June 22, 2026 (91 FR 38233) continue year by year; the last continues it beyond June 26, 2026, a date after the cutoff, and each lists Executive Order 14033 among the orders taking steps under it. Executive Order 14140 of January 8, 2025 amended only section 1 of this order by striking and inserting; that is a later event on each section 1 clause, and the other sections are unchanged. The held eCFR text of 31 CFR 588.201 and 588.106, checked as of 2026-10-14, still implements the order. The Federal Register disposition note lists the cross-references to Executive Orders 13219 and 13304, Proclamation 8693 and the Notices of June 20, 2025 and June 22, 2026; Executive Order 14294 of May 9, 2025 is a general policy and reporting order on criminal regulatory offenses that does not name this order and does not end any clause.
